description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the IDGeneratorService within the OrangeHRM project. It tests the generation of sequential IDs for various entities like Employee, Location, JobCategory, etc., using mock dependencies.

classes.name: IDGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ID generation service methods in the OrangeHRM project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the IDGeneratorService before each test.

methods.name: testGetNextID
methods.description: Tests the getNextID method for various entity IDs, verifying correct ID formatting and incrementation.

methods.name: getNextIDDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for different entity types and their expected next IDs.

methods.name: testIncrementId
methods.description: Tests the incrementId method to ensure it correctly increments the current ID for an entity.
